title: Binance Adds ARB/TUSD, ARB/EUR, ARB/TRY, ID/TUSD, ID/EUR & ID/TRY Trading Pairs
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will open trading for the ARB/TUSD, ARB/EUR, ARB/TRY, ID/TUSD, ID/EUR and ID/TRY trading pairs at  2023-03-24 08:00 (UTC) . Start Trading on Binance Spot Now! Notes: Users will enjoy zero maker fees on the ARB/TUSD and ID/TUSD trading pairs until further notice. EUR and TRY are fiat currencies and do not represent any other digital currencies. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support!
